Title: Heidelberg Castle, Germany VS Blood Hunt Referendum

Messages.Author: Rémi
Messages.Body:
Dear all,

The basic question is can I use Heidelberg Castle, Germany before a Blood Hunt Referendum? Same question but during the Blood Hunt Referendum?

Official card text of that Location :

Name: Heidelberg Castle, Germany
AKA: Heidelburg Castle, Germany
[DS:U2, FN:PR, KMW:PAl, LoB:PI, 25th:1]
Cardtype: Master
Cost: 2 pool
Unique location.
Lock to move blood, equipment and/or retainers between any two ready vampires you control. Cannot be used during an action.

Case 1:
Vampire A diablerizes Vampire B by the rulebook action.
May I use the master before/during the BloodHunt Referendum ?

Case 2:
Vampire A diablerizes Vampire B by Amaranth.
Name: Amaranth
[Jyhad:U, VTES:U, CE:U, Anarchs:PAG, BH:PTo2, Third:PTz, KoT:U]
Cardtype: Combat
Only usable by a vampire who can commit diablerie. Only usable when the opposing vampire should go to torpor. Diablerize the opposing vampire instead. Not usable by a vampire being burned or going to torpor.

May I use the master before/during the BloodHunt Referendum ?
I would think no because Amaranth is a combat card and I would understand that Combat
always belongs to an action (action's effect of Combat after a successful block attempt or even Hidden Lurker)

Cas 3:
Vampire A resolves successful Abactor's action
Name: Abactor
[Promo-20090401]
Cardtype: Action
+1 stealth{} action.
{Hunt at +4 hunt}. After successful resolution, a referendum is called to call a blood hunt on this vampire (independent of the action, just as if {they} had committed diablerie).

May I use the master before/during the BloodHunt Referendum ?

Thanks in advance,
Regards,
Rémi.

Messages.Author: kschaefer
Messages.Body:
